notes: Corrected: in both measurement chains the single written *the* goes to the present article morpheme on the rectum, fronted by English onto the construct, rather than to a supplied article on the construct while the present article is marked `unrepresented`. Rule 29 supplies a *the* on a construct only where no article morpheme is present and marks an article `unrepresented` only where the ASV writes no *the* for the phrase at all; EXO.36.29's *in the two corners* unit reads an identical shape the same way.
The determiner *each* stays with אַחַת/אֶחָת, so the agreement articles s004 and s020 remain `unrepresented` under rule 47.
*had* on the possessive לְ follows rule 43's verbless case.
